translations.web: Day and night they prowl around on its walls. Malice and abuse are also within her.
translations.bsb: Day and night they encircle the walls, while malice and trouble lie within.
translations.kjv: Day and night they go about it upon the walls thereof: mischief also and sorrow are in the midst
translations.asv: Day and night they go about it upon the walls thereof: Iniquity also and mischief are in the midst of it.
